Name: Giulia Viggiano
Bio: Giulia Viggiano is a sophomore studying Chemical Engineering with a minor in Bioengineering and plans to pursue the Engineering Corporate Practice minor. Originally from New York City, she studied abroad in Rome, Italy through the ND Engineering summer program. On campus, Giulia is a Hypatia Scholar who lives in Grojean Hall, where she serves as a commissioner, and she is also involved with SWE. She previously served as the social media co-chair for the First-Year Engineering Council (FYEC) and is currently serving on ELC's social committee.
